gaps.quote: It calls the established multiplier on records whose length is $O(rp)$
gaps.note: The page uses record as a unit of data without saying what it is; the reader cannot tell what a record of length O(rp) contains.

gaps.quote: The cost of that product is charged once per record, and the total cost of all such products is part of the final cost bound.
gaps.note: The page does not say how the cost is charged or how the total enters the final bound, so the reader cannot check the claim.
